{{Quote|Go ahead and have a look around; entertain yourselves. There's a cantina that way.|[[Kad Solus/Legends|Kad Solus]], directing [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives to the Sheb Niktose|<ref name="FLT" />}}
The '''Sheb Niktose''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]]. Situated near a clear [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] [[lake]], the Sheb Niktose was part of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of [[Arumorut/Legends|Arumorut]]. The cantina was easily recognized by the sign that hung out front depicting a cartoonish image of an [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armored]] Mandalorian [[Boot/Legends|boot]] striking a [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto's]] backside. The cantina's interior was dimly lit, with an intimate pub atmosphere frequented by local regulars. The Sheb Niktose's menu included four-[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] [[Glass/Legends|glasses]] of bitter [[Kri'gee/Legends|''kri'gee'']], five-credit glasses of the clear [[Spirit (alcohol)|spirit]] ''[[Tihaar/Legends|tihaar]]'', and six-credit mugs of sweet, [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Black ale/Legends|''ne'tra gal'']].<ref name="FLT" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the rebel [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the Sheb Niktose was staffed by a young Mandalorian [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] nicknamed "[[Adiik]],"<ref name="FLT" /> meaning "kid" in the [[Mando'a/Legends|''Mando'a'']] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="Mando'a">{{WebCite|url=http://www.karentraviss.com/page20/page26/index.html|text=Mando'a|author=Karen Traviss|work=[http://www.karentraviss.com Karen Traviss]|archivedate=20110925083955}}</ref> [[Teroch/Legends|Teroch]], a Mandalorian veteran and resident of Arumorut, could be found on occasion at the Sheb Niktose, drinking ''ne'tra gal'' with his peers. When a group of rebel operatives traveled to Vlemoth Port to seek the aid of the local Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], they spent [[Time/Legends|time]] at the Sheb Niktose while they waited to meet with the leader of the mercenaries, [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera Beroya]]. There, the rebels were invited to join Teroch at the bar, and the old Mandalorian drank several shots of ''tihaar'' with the rebel agents while discussing Arumorut's history.<ref name="FLT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Sheb Niktose cantina was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Age of Rebellion'']] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published [[December 8]], [[2016]].
